observations: Generated-original inline preview shows an 8-column by 4-row sheet with 32 complete sprites, empty hands and separated transparent gutters.
Gray stone skin, amber-gold eyes, long chunky gray stone braids with gold bands, teal/gold tunic panels and belt are retained with a modest natural feminine presentation.
Eight expected headings are readable at source size, including distinct back-quarter and direct-back views; no gross facing swap was observed.
Row 2 folds legs and tucks feet while row 3 extends the legs toward landing; row 4 bends knees and lowers the body more deeply than row 1.
Common skull dimensions appear broadly maintained across rows; this is a qualitative source-size observation, not a native-size measurement.
No cropped extremities, weapons, magic, captions, floor or ground shadow were observed in the generated-original preview.
Fine red/yellow edge speckles and partial alpha are present in the untouched generated source.
limitations: E/W profiles remain slightly three-quarter in some poses, and front-facing rising feet overlap beneath the tunic; exact heading and leg-silhouette readability require lead native-scale review.
Some hands are naturally partly occluded in rear views.

The local view_image rendering unexpectedly displayed mostly edge fringes, while the generator's original inline preview displayed full characters. File SHA256 stayed unchanged, and read-only pixel inspection found valid RGB with body alpha typically 252-253. This display-path discrepancy is not resolved here.
No alpha cleanup, hidden-RGB removal, registration, per-cell extraction, skull-size measurement, downsampling or source-to-runtime comparison was performed.
These are four authored key poses, not complete animation cycles or cast poses.
